commands.name: continue-session

commands.name: stop-session

commands.name: manage-sessions
commands.title: Manage Sessions
commands.description: Start, stop, edit, and delete work sessions and browse your session history.

commands.name: session-status
commands.title: Session Status
commands.description: Show your active session and elapsed time in the menu bar.

tools.name: get-current-session
tools.title: Get Current Session
tools.description: Get your active work session, including its project and start time. Returns null when no session is active.

tools.name: list-sessions
tools.title: List Sessions
tools.description: List your work sessions from newest to oldest, with offset pagination.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: List the active projects you can track time in, including their IDs.

tools.name: start-session
tools.title: Start Session
tools.description: Start a work session with a description and project, automatically stopping your current session first. Also use this to continue a previous session with the same details.

tools.name: stop-session
tools.title: Stop Session
tools.description: Stop your active work session. Does nothing when no session is active.

tools.name: edit-session
tools.title: Edit Session
tools.description: Update a session's description, project, remote work setting, or start and end times. Omitted fields stay unchanged.

tools.name: delete-session
tools.title: Delete Session
tools.description: Permanently delete one of your work sessions after confirmation.

ai.instructions: Use List Projects to resolve project names to IDs and Get Current Session or List Sessions to resolve session IDs. Never invent IDs. To continue a session, use Start Session with its description, project ID, and remote work setting; this creates a new session and stops the current one. Session history is paginated: follow has_more using offset before claiming a complete total or that an older session does not exist. Provide timestamps in UTC ISO 8601 format. Only change fields the user asks to update.
